notes.title: The Big Update Is Almost Here!
notes.content:
Hey Realm Watchers, 


We’ve got some exciting news: our massive update is right around the corner! 

We’re not talking months anymore - it’s down to just about a week and a half. (We won’t drop the exact date just yet, but trust us: it’s really that close). 



In this announcement, you’ll finally get another real look at a few abilities from the brand-new combat system!


Use the holy dash to shatter corruption and the skulls of your enemies 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/4ab312ce062b03f9bc41ada403c54dbbf462b4d5.gif"]


Pierce their flesh with shards of ice


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/f4fd04d8e35bfb573bfec79d45e3d2177b908306.gif"]


Let the shadows conceal you until the perfect moment to strike


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/038bdb76c3dbf19a450142ba7487dc24e11c226b.gif"]





A smoother, freshly polished UI We’re a small indie team, which means our game isn’t some mass-produced “canned soup.” It’s more like a slow-cooked recipe straight from grandma’s kitchen-made with love, care, and way too many late nights. And soon, you’ll get to taste it for yourself.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/62f0980319234f3e1fee888ad2c48e34982fe1b1.gif"]



    

Thank you for being on this journey with us - it truly means the world. The wait is almost over - get ready!



Your Realm Watch Team

notes.title: A Glimpse into the Next Realm
notes.content:
🕯 Rise of the Lore 🕯

We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and we’re beyond excited for what’s coming next to Realm Watch.  

Every monster in our world gets its own lore — and today, we’re giving you an early peek at one of the horrors awaiting you in the next level. 


Meet the Jelly of Agony — a higher demon born in the depths of Umbraeth, god of shadow and the underworld. It stalks reflections and shadows, luring prey with illusions of beauty before breaking them completely. 


We can’t wait to share more in the upcoming updates — for now, enjoy this early concept art… and don’t stare too long.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/01fae69f2ff79d70195ffa762a945382a3164bdb.jpg"]

notes.title: Realms Yet Unseen
notes.content:
⚒️ Exciting Development Update! ⚒️

Hey Realm Watchers!


We wanted to share a more in-depth look at what we’re currently working on for Realm Watch. A lot has been happening behind the scenes, and we’re excited to bring you along for the journey:


🔧 Smoother Animations & Improved Visual Flow
We’ve overhauled many of our character animations to feel more fluid and natural. This includes everything from basic movement to attack combos and dodges. The goal is to make every action feel responsive and grounded, so that when you swing a blade or cast a spell, it feels right. These changes will also help combat look more cinematic without losing that gritty, dark fantasy edge.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/be8c86ebab99f725ab6940159b1b396376ef139b.gif"]
⚔️ A More Dynamic Combat System
Combat is evolving. We're integrating mechanics that reward timing, positioning, and tactical choices — not just stats. Expect more impactful hit feedback, improved enemy behavior, and new abilities that synergize with your playstyle. Whether you prefer aggressive melee, clever traps, or controlling the battlefield with magic, the system will offer tools for meaningful expression.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/8faa06663e8e65089368f79f5201c2df85c9557e.gif"]


📈 New Leveling System with Stat Progression
We’ve added a new leveling system that gives players a simple but meaningful way to grow their characters. With each level, you’ll gain stat points that slightly improve things like damage, defense, or stamina — no complicated menus or builds, just a light touch of progression that keeps you feeling stronger over time.


🌐 Multiplayer Development Has Begun
We’ve started laying the groundwork for multiplayer functionality. This is a major technical undertaking, as we want the experience to be as seamless and stable as possible. Because of its complexity, multiplayer will not launch with the base game — instead, we’re planning it as a major post-launch update. Our goal is to make co-op gameplay immersive and strategic, not just a bolt-on feature.


🎙️ Animated Intro, Voice Acting and Community Artifact Vote!
We’re incredibly excited to reveal that we’ve teamed up with voice actors and a skilled visual artist to create a fully animated intro sequence. This cinematic will serve as a dramatic entry point into the world of Realm Watch, setting the tone for the conflict, the corruption, and the fragile alliances that drive the story forward. It's more than just a cutscene — it's a piece of the world we're building with care. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576618/d4b2b87b8e0667acc06342dd31a18927155922fa.jpg"]
From August 6th to 10th, you can join our community event on social media where we’ll be sharing different illustrations of powerful in-game artifacts. You’ll be able to vote for your favorite — and the winning artifact will appear in the official animated intro!

Nebrumluminux

We’ll keep sharing updates as we go. Thanks so much for being part of this journey — your support makes all of this possible. Stay tuned for more content soon!



— The Realm Watch Team

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've just rolled out a small update with a few fixes. 
Thanks for your continued feedback and support!

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the currency value displayed in the HUD could be incorrect if the building menu was closed after being opened.
Addressed a camera problem that could occur when the player was positioned close to a tower.
Resolved a visibility issue with the Sunfire Tower.


We'll continue to monitor for any further issues. As always, please let us know if you encounter anything else!

- Your CodeMates Team
